title: Goldreich–Levin failure probability bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $0<\tau\le 1$. For every natural number $k\le n$, the outer probability that the run of the Goldreich–Levin query algorithm through stage $k$ has an inaccurate estimate is at most $k$ times the stage failure budget.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
stage index $k$ is a natural number
